quests.title: The Nutrition Detective Laboratory
quests.description: Investigate how plants and animals get their food and become a Nutrition Detective!

story.introduction: Welcome to the Nutrition Detective Lab! Dr. Foodie has discovered mysterious eating habits in nature. Help solve the cases of how different living things get their nutrition!

steps.title: The Photosynthesis Factory Tour
steps.narrative: Visit the amazing Photosynthesis Factory inside a leaf! Discover how plants make their own food using sunlight, water, and air.

problem.question: What do plants need to make food through photosynthesis?
problem.explanation: Brilliant discovery! Plants are like amazing chefs - they use sunlight as energy, water from roots, and carbon dioxide from air to cook their own food (glucose)!

steps.title: The Digestive System Journey
steps.narrative: Shrink down and take an incredible journey through the human digestive system! Follow food from mouth to... well, the end!

problem.question: Where does digestion begin in the human body?
problem.explanation: Perfect journey start! Digestion begins in the mouth where teeth break down food and saliva starts the chemical breakdown. What an amazing system!

steps.title: Food Chain Ecosystem Mission
steps.narrative: Explore the interconnected world of food chains! Discover how energy flows from plants to animals in nature's perfect system.

problem.question: In this food chain: Grass → Rabbit → Fox, what is the rabbit?
problem.explanation: Excellent ecosystem understanding! The rabbit is a primary consumer because it eats plants (producers). The fox would be a secondary consumer!

steps.title: The Nutrition Master Challenge
steps.narrative: Face the ultimate test! The Nutrition Master challenges you to solve a complex case involving both plant and animal nutrition!

problem.question: A farmer notices his crops are yellow and not growing well, while his animals are healthy. What might be the problem?
options: Plants lack proper nutrients or sunlight
problem.correct_answer: Plants lack proper nutrients or sunlight
problem.explanation: Master detective work! Yellow, poorly growing plants usually indicate lack of nutrients (especially nitrogen) or insufficient sunlight for photosynthesis!

quests.title: The Heat and Temperature Laboratory
quests.description: Explore the exciting world of heat and temperature in Dr. Thermal's amazing laboratory!

story.introduction: Dr. Thermal's laboratory is full of hot and cold mysteries! Learn about heat transfer, thermal expansion, and temperature measurement through exciting experiments!

steps.title: Temperature Measurement Station
steps.narrative: Dr. Thermal shows you different thermometers and temperature scales. Learn to measure heat like a true scientist!

problem.question: At what temperature does water freeze?
problem.explanation: Perfect measurement! Water freezes at 0°C (32°F). This is why we get ice when it's very cold outside!

steps.title: Heat Transfer Expedition
steps.narrative: Embark on an expedition to discover the three ways heat travels: conduction, convection, and radiation!

problem.question: When you touch a hot metal spoon, heat travels to your hand through:
problem.explanation: Excellent understanding! Conduction is heat transfer through direct contact. The hot metal transfers heat directly to your skin - that's why it feels hot!

steps.title: Thermal Expansion Workshop
steps.narrative: Discover why things expand when heated and contract when cooled! This knowledge helps engineers build better structures.

problem.question: Why do railway tracks have small gaps between them?
problem.explanation: Brilliant engineering insight! Railway tracks expand when hot and contract when cold. Gaps prevent the tracks from bending or breaking!

steps.title: Defeat the Thermal Energy Master
steps.narrative: The final thermal challenge! The Thermal Energy Master controls all heat in the kingdom. Prove your mastery to restore thermal balance!

problem.question: Which material would be best for making a cooking pot handle?
problem.explanation: Thermal mastery achieved! Wood is a poor conductor of heat (good insulator), so it won't burn your hand when the pot is hot. Safety first!

quests.title: The Acid-Base Chemistry Quest
quests.description: Enter the colorful world of acids and bases and become a Chemistry Color Master!

story.introduction: Professor Litmus has lost control of his acid-base laboratory! Colors are changing everywhere, and only a Chemistry Color Master can restore order using indicators and neutralization!

steps.title: Acid Identification Chamber
steps.narrative: Enter the Acid Chamber where sour substances reveal their secrets! Learn to identify acids by their properties.

problem.question: Which of these is an acid commonly found in your kitchen?
problem.explanation: Excellent identification! Lemon juice contains citric acid, which makes it sour. Acids have a sour taste and turn blue litmus paper red!

steps.title: Base Detection Laboratory
steps.narrative: Now explore the Base Laboratory! Bases have different properties from acids. Use your detective skills to identify them!

problem.question: What happens when you touch soap with wet hands?
problem.explanation: Great observation! Soap is a base, and bases feel slippery or soapy to touch. This slippery feeling helps soap clean things!

steps.title: The Indicator Magic Show
steps.narrative: Watch the amazing color-changing magic show! Indicators change colors to reveal whether substances are acids or bases.

problem.question: Red litmus paper turns blue when dipped in:
problem.explanation: Magical color change mastered! Red litmus turns blue in bases. Remember: 'Red to Blue = Base is true!' This helps us identify bases easily.

steps.title: Neutralization Wizard Duel
steps.narrative: The final challenge! The Neutralization Wizard has created chaos by mixing acids and bases. Use neutralization to restore balance!

problem.question: What happens when an acid and base are mixed in the right amounts?
problem.explanation: Neutralization mastery! When acids and bases neutralize each other, they form salt and water. The dangerous properties cancel out - perfect balance!
